_comment: Display knowledge about lexical sources, extracted from mt-eval-arena/scripts/build-trading-card-data.mjs assembleVocabulary() so it is declared data instead of code. `priority` orders sources for vocabulary display (display-ready orthography first; ASJP always last — ASJPcode is a phonetic encoding, not reader-facing). `displayTypes` labels how a source's forms render: native (orthography/practical transcription, the default), ipa, or asjp-phonetic (needs a UI label). Consumed by cli/scripts/cldf/emit-forms.mjs (ordering + tagging) and the catalogue build.
